title: Integral mean-value formula for a Lipschitz map with continuous a.e. derivative
statement: Let n, l >= 0, f : R^n -> R^l, g : R^n -> L(R^n, R^l), U ⊆ R^n open and convex, and K >= 0. Suppose f is K-Lipschitz on U, g is continuous on U, and for Lebesgue-almost every x ∈ U the map f has Frechet derivative g(x) at x. Then for all x, y ∈ U: f(y) - f(x) = integral_0^1 g(x + tau(y - x))(y - x) dtau.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (f : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (g : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ)) (U : Set (Rn n)) (K : ℝ≥0), IsOpen U → Convex ℝ U → LipschitzOnWith K f U → ContinuousOn g U → (∀ᵐ x ∂(volume : Measure (Rn n)), x ∈ U → HasFDerivAt f (g x) x) → ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ y ∈ U, f y - f x = ∫ τ in (0:ℝ)..1, g (x + τ • (y - x)) (y - x)
